environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed via AWS CDK with custom container image runtime. The container uses a minimal distroless base with a custom seccomp profile applied via the Lambda container's OCI runtime spec override (configured through the internal ECS task definition backing the Lambda execution environment). The seccomp profile operates in whitelist mode allowing only: read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocedure, ioctl, access, open, openat, stat, poll, lseek, getpid, clone, futex, sched_yield, nanosleep, clock_gettime, epoll_wait, epoll_ctl, getrandom, exit_group. Notably blocks execve, ptrace, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept. Additionally, the Step Functions state machine definition specifies a HeartbeatSeconds of 5 on the Task state, and the Lambda function memory is set to 128MB with a 30-second timeout.
